Absent version keeps a directly requested version or selects the newest non-deleted child for a root; an empty-but-present version selects latest with deleted rows included; a truthy version selects the validated explicit id.
Archive is used only when original=true was not requested and the effective document has an archive.
serve_file chooses archive_file for archive responses and source_file otherwise.
Author explanation not supplied.

gaps: The actual global documents.view_document model grant is external and must be supplied to conclude that DRF invokes the handler.
When the root is owned by another user, the actual guardian view_document object-grant result is external and must be supplied to conclude authorization.
Actual database rows and soft-deletion state are not supplied; documents is a finite stand-in for manager results, so real document/version existence remains conditional.
Actual storage/file existence is not supplied; selection of a path does not prove that FileResponse succeeds rather than raising FileNotFoundError and becoming HTTP 404.
The executable workflow models the chosen file handle, not public filename generation, MIME/header construction, filesystem/backend I/O, throttling, or deployment/proxy behavior.

Invalid non-integer version values and absent or unrelated explicit version ids lead to NotFound/404 in source; the finite model leaves malformed integer conversion or no-match values unresolved/null rather than constructing HTTP exceptions.
